name: xcelsior
description: Rent and manage GPUs on Xcelsior Compute

interface.shortDescription: Rent GPUs by the hour or run serverless inference, priced in CAD
interface.longDescription: Xcelsior is a distributed GPU marketplace where independent hosts compete on price. Discover live GPU availability and spot pricing, estimate what a job will cost before you commit, launch and monitor instances, and call serverless inference endpoints. Launches and destructive actions go through a launch plan that you approve before anything runs or is billed.
defaultPrompt: What is the cheapest GPU on Xcelsior right now with at least 24 GB of VRAM?
Plan a 4-hour fine-tuning run on Xcelsior and tell me what it will cost before launching.
Show my running Xcelsior instances and what they are costing me.
